summary: We developed a game in Unity as part of a space mission design challenge. It is significant because it inspires players to explore the unknown reaches of space and confront challenges; the game is intended for pre-adolescent children who are mature enough to understand that it is fiction, while also helping them develop the courage to face the unknown.
details: This is an exploration and survival game designed to encourage the courage to face the unknown. The project centers on a fantastical story about a team that manages to survive a failed mission. We used tools such as Unity and Blender, programmed in C#, and utilized development assistants like Codex and Claude Code. The project was a collective effort, born from the imagination of every team member, with each person contributing their own ideas. Our goal was to create an engaging, educational, and visually striking experience, set in an environment on the Moon.
